parsed.refutation_attempt: The source of the filename is a hard-coded string literal, not an external or user-controlled input (stdin, argv, environment, network, etc.). Since there is no untrusted data reaching fopen, there is no path from a source to the sink, and no trigger exists to cause command injection or arbitrary file overwrite. The claim of a symlink attack is a separate risk but does not correspond to OS Command Injection (CWE-78) and is mitigated by appropriate file system permissions. Therefore the finding is refuted.
